SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - FICTIONAL PATIENT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE
COLONOSCOPY REPORT
Facility: Bramblewood Endoscopy Suite (fictional)
Patient: Oren Castellane (fictional)
Date of service: November 6, 2026
Endoscopist: Lucia Fenwright, MD (fictional)
Indication: Change in bowel habit.
Procedure: The colonoscope was advanced to the cecum and the terminal ileum was intubated.
Bowel preparation was excellent.
Findings:
- Transverse colon: a 12 mm sessile polyp with a regular surface pattern.
- The polyp was removed en bloc with a cold snare and retrieved for histology.
- Hot snare was not used. No submucosal injection was given before or after the resection.
- The defect was clean, with no residual tissue at the margins and no bleeding.
- Terminal ileum and remainder of the colon: normal.
Impression:
1. 12 mm transverse colon polyp, removed en bloc by cold snare.
2. Otherwise normal colonoscopy to the terminal ileum.
Plan: Await pathology to set the surveillance interval.
